findings.text: follow-on: unwatch signals the registered project watcher through _signal_process_group with no sender record, and the followup names recovery.unwatch among the paths that must write one; the manifest discloses it under follow_ons on the grounds that a watcher is not a run, which is a defensible scope call but leaves the enumerated path unwired.

follow-on: the sender record is written before the identity and self-signal guards in _signal_process_group (each call site writes it, then calls into the guard), so a signal the guard refuses still leaves a senders.jsonl line naming a SIGTERM that was never delivered; reproduced by writing a record then calling _signal_process_group with a mismatched start time, which raised CrewError and left a run-stop/SIGTERM line on disk, so a prevented kill reads as an attributed one.

follow-on: the manifest records the base and head arm results only in the free-text tests: and test_logs: lines and omits the machine-readable baseline_suite and after_suite fields, so a reader that derives added failures from the manifest (the review annotation and the promotion suite-delta check) reads this run's suite evidence as unmeasured rather than as the measured zero the two arm logs show; both arm files also name the base revision b5dbaaa2 on their header line, the head arm self-labelling as '+ working tree', so the head measurement cannot be tied to the landed revision 346d49cd from either log.

item_verdicts.diff: read revision 346d49cd against base b5dbaaa2; routing.py +121 (SENDER_RECORD_NAME, run_directory_of, _write_sender_record, and signal_worker/_signal_process_group gaining reason and run_dir), six call sites wired, the gate test +160, the fragment +112.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_every_signal_leaves_a_sender_record.py, a grep receipt and a negative control; the manifest records the gate, both arms and the negative control, and all four reproduce here (gate 4 passed, grep receipt exact, negative control 2 failed EXIT=1, arms 10/10).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that every path signalling a run writes a sender record into that run's directory before it signals, through one shared writer; reckon/crew/routing.py:1388 defines _write_sender_record and it is reached from the dispatch, recovery and promotion signalling arms, with recovery.unwatch:7384 still signalling without a record.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, naming the shared writer, the reason per path, the gate, both arms, the negative control and their logs; it omits the machine-readable baseline_suite/after_suite fields and discloses unwatch under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are the six reckon/crew modules, the gate test and the evidence fragment; git show --stat 346d49cd touches exactly those eight files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the negative control proves the two record assertions in tests/test_every_signal_leaves_a_sender_record.py redden when _write_sender_record is a no-op, but no test drives a production call site (dispatch.terminate, the budget watchdog, promotion release) end to end, so a dropped _write_sender_record call in any of those arms would leave the suite green.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's three artefacts reproduce against 346d49cd (gate 4 passed in a scratch tree, the grep receipt shows no signal-delivering os.kill or os.killpg outside routing.py, negative control 2 failed EXIT=1), but the manifest states the arm results only in free-text tests: and test_logs: lines and omits baseline_suite/after_suite, so the read-time and promotion suite-delta readers see them as unmeasured.
justifications.fit: SENDER_RECORD_NAME at routing.py:1364, the append-a-JSON-line writer and run_directory_of follow the module's existing named-constant and dict-returning-helper idiom, and the added names carry no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: routing.py:1388 _write_sender_record is called before the signal from the dispatch rollback, lane-change and terminate arms, the recovery delivered-review and budget-watchdog arms, and the promotion settle and release arms, but recovery.py:7384 unwatch signals the registered watcher with no record even though the followup names it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 346d49cd lists exactly the six declared reckon/crew modules, the gate test and the evidence fragment, and the fleet_supervisor and standing_suite edits are the shared-home rerouting the goal implies.
